title: Dedication
text: DEDICATED TO STAN, CHRISTOPHER AND MICHELE RICE TO SUZANNE SCOTT QUIROZ AND VICTORIA WILSON TO THE MEMORY OF JOHN PRESTON TO THE IRISH OF NEW ORLEANS WHO, IN THE 1850S , BUILT ON CONSTANCE STREET THE GREAT CHURCH OF ST. ALPHONSUS , WHILE PASSING ON TO US THROUGH FAITH, ARCHITECTURE AND ART A SPLENDID MONUMENT TO “THE GLORY THAT WAS GREECE AND THE GRANDEUR THAT WAS ROME”
